caption: The video captures a kitchen interior where a hand grips the black handle of a round glass coffee carafe filled with dark reddish-brown liquid, holding it close to the camera on the right. Behind it, a gas stove supports a black frying pan beneath a metallic range hood and wooden cabinets, while an orange wall, a doorway, and hanging metal tools at the left edge stay at fixed screen positions. Throughout the excerpt the hand slowly rotates and lowers the carafe, so the metal lid and spout assembly, cut off by the upper frame edge at the start, comes into full view. As the vessel turns, the line of the coffee surface tilts and reorients with the glass. Bright reflections, including a room-light rectangle and a dark person-silhouette, slide across the curved surface. The black handle shifts from a near-horizontal grip toward a more vertical orientation, and the metal base appears at the lower right. The background remains still, making the moving carafe and hand the only visible motion. Reorientation continues through the clip.
